rationale: The short thesis is confirming rather than invalidating — price just broke the day-low on the heaviest down-volume since entry, sits below both VWAP ($42.10) and the 9-EMA ($40.41), and the negative tape (SPY -0.70%, VIXY +2.20%) with the unfilled gap at $38.89 supports continuation toward the $39.40 target. A flip to long would be counter-trend scalping at the lows of a distribution day with no reversal evidence, and closing here means exiting at the exact session low while ~$0.55 of planned target remains. Squeeze-bounce risk is the main threat, but the $40.85 invalidation sits above the 9-EMA and has not been threatened, so holding with the original levels retains a favorable structure.
